question: What fate befalls a Vaiṣṇava who acts without knowing this teaching?
premises: A Vaiṣṇava may act without knowing.
Such a person goes to Raurava.
The warning is addressed to the fair-complexioned one.
inference: A Vaiṣṇava who acts without knowledge goes to Raurava.
plain_english: O fair-complexioned one, a Vaiṣṇava who acts without knowing goes to Raurava.
